name: confirm-pass-check
blurb: Password form with strength indicator and confirmation matching validation.
description: A complete password input form with real-time strength scoring based on character requirements (length, digits, case, special chars), show/hide toggle, and confirmation field matching with visual feedback.
use_when: Building registration, password reset, or account creation forms that require password strength validation and confirmation.
avoid_when: When password requirements are simpler or when you need custom validation logic.
a11y: Uses aria-invalid for validation states, aria-describedby to link strength info, show/hide button has aria-label, requirements list has aria-label.
